articles.title: Astronaut Spots a Fireball from Space — Was It a Rocket Part?
articles.summary: Imagine seeing a shooting star from above! NASA astronaut Chris Williams watched a bright fireball break apart over West Africa. It might have been a rocket part falling back to Earth.

articles.title: Pink Bug Turns Green to Hide Like a Leaf!
articles.summary: Scientists found a katydid that changed from hot pink to green in 11 days. It might be copying rainforest leaves that start pink and then turn green.

articles.title: Robot Hands Are Learning to Feel!
articles.summary: A company called DAIMON Robotics made a huge dataset to teach robot hands how to sense touch. They shared 10,000 hours of data so robots can get better at tasks like folding laundry.
